description_en:
Designed specifically for document translation. Supports translation between more than 100 language pairs (including bridged pairs) to handle multi-scenario, multi-page, and highly complex document translation. Scanned documents are not currently supported.
Excels in the following areas:
Content accuracy: translation accuracy, parameter and unit accuracy.
Structural integrity: overall layout continuity, page margin and layout restoration
description_zh:
专为文档翻译研发，支持100多种(含桥接)语向之间的互译，满足多场景&多页数&高复杂度文档翻译，暂不支持扫描件。
在以下方面表现出色：
内容准确性：翻译准确性，参数与单位准确性。
结构合理性：整体排版连续性，页面边距与布局还原性

name: DocumentTranslate

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL of the document to be translated
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文档的OSS URL路径
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The target language. The language code uses the two-letter ISO 639-1 standard
parameters.help_zh: 目标语向，语言代码采用ISO639-1标准的两位字母表示法
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en:
The supported document types: PDF/Word.  
Supported capacity limits:  
word: 200 MB/100 pages 
PDF: 200 MB/100 pages  
Maximum size per file: 200 MB
parameters.help_zh:
支持文档的类型：PDF/word  
支持的容量限制：  
word 200MB/100页 
PDF 200MB/100页  
单个文件最大200MB
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The glossary ID. Specify this parameter when you need the glossary feature. Supports custom translation results, including do-not-translate (ABC-ABC), specified translation (ABC-DEF), and skip translation (ABC-empty value). This is commonly used for scenarios such as brand name protection
parameters.help_zh: 需要干预功能时填写干预词表ID。支持自定义翻译结果，包含不被翻译（ABC-ABC），指定翻译（ABC-DEF），不翻译（ABC-空值），常用于品牌词保护等场景
parameters.name: glossary
